title: To the newlywed - Hisn al-Muslim 190
arabic: بارَكَ اللّهُ لَك، وَبارَكَ عَلَـيْك، وَجَمَعَ بَيْـنَكُما في خَـيْر
transliteration: Bārakallāhu lak, wa bāraka `alayk, wa jama`a baynakumā fī khayr
translation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah and At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/316
